fullText.simplified:
第1章、十年

    这是南方的一个小城，名字叫新也。四十多岁的刘备骑着马，在街上慢慢地走着。街上的人不少，来来去去的人从他身边经过，他没有看他们。
    街边有一些梅子树，刘备站在树下看了一会儿，想起自己以前在河南和曹操在梅子树下喝过酒，他难过地说：“时间过得真快，已经十年了！”
    没错，刘备从北方来南方已经十年了。这十年里他一直住在荆州。荆州的刘表有很多军队，他可以照顾刘备和刘备带来的人。当然，刘表也知道刘备是个有能力的人，把他留在荆州可以帮自己，所以他对刘备也不错。
    但是，刘表的助手和将军们不这么想，他们觉得刘备太有能力了，把这样的人留在荆州不是什么好事。他们一直对刘表说，刘备是个危险的人，不能留他在荆州，还是杀了他吧。刘表听得多了，慢慢也有点儿不相信刘备了。他不敢给刘备军队，也不敢让刘备做大官，只给了他一个叫“新也”的小城，让他好吃好穿地住在那里。
    刘表的一个大将军觉得刘表太胆小了，杀刘备是件容易的事，为什么不敢呢？有一天，这个将军请刘备去他家吃饭，想在饭桌上把刘备杀了。但他没准备好，有人把他要杀刘备的事告诉了刘备。刘备听了，饭也没吃，马上骑着马从小路跑了。
fullText.traditional:
第1章、十年

    這是南方的一個小城，名字叫新也。四十多歲的劉備騎著馬，在街上慢慢地走著。街上的人不少，來來去去的人從他身邊經過，他沒有看他們。
    街邊有一些梅子樹，劉備站在樹下看了一會兒，想起自己以前在河南和曹操在梅子樹下喝過酒，他難過地說：“時間過得真快，已經十年了！”
    沒錯，劉備從北方來南方已經十年了。這十年裡他一直住在荊州。荊州的劉表有很多軍隊，他可以照顧劉備和劉備帶來的人。當然，劉表也知道劉備是個有能力的人，把他留在荊州可以幫自己，所以他對劉備也不錯。
    但是，劉表的助手和將軍們不這麼想，他們覺得劉備太有能力了，把這樣的人留在荊州不是什麼好事。他們一直對劉表說，劉備是個危險的人，不能留他在荊州，還是殺了他吧。劉表聽得多了，慢慢也有點兒不相信劉備了。他不敢給劉備軍隊，也不敢讓劉備做大官，只給了他一個叫“新也”的小城，讓他好吃好穿地住在那裡。
    劉表的一個大將軍覺得劉表太膽小了，殺劉備是件容易的事，為什麼不敢呢？有一天，這個將軍請劉備去他家吃飯，想在飯桌上把劉備殺了。但他沒準備好，有人把他要殺劉備的事告訴了劉備。劉備聽了，飯也沒吃，馬上騎著馬從小路跑了。

sentences.simplified: 这是南方的一个小城，名字叫新也。四十多岁的刘备骑着马，在街上慢慢地走着。
sentences.traditional: 這是南方的一個小城，名字叫新也。四十多歲的劉備騎著馬，在街上慢慢地走著。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì nán fāng de yí ge xiǎo chéng míng zi jiào xīn yě sì shí duō suì de liú bèi qí zhe mǎ zài jiē shang màn man de zǒu zhe
sentences.english: This is a small city in the south called Xinye. Liu Bei, in his forties, was riding his horse slowly on the street.

sentences.simplified: 街上的人不少，来来去去的人从他身边经过，他没有看他们。
sentences.traditional: 街上的人不少，來來去去的人從他身邊經過，他沒有看他們。
sentences.pinyin: jiē shang de rén bù shǎo lái lái qù qù de rén cóng tā shēn biān jīng guò tā méi yǒu kàn tā men
sentences.english: There were quite a few people on the street. People came and went, passing by him, but he did not look at them.

sentences.simplified: 街边有一些梅子树，刘备站在树下看了一会儿，
sentences.traditional: 街邊有一些梅子樹，劉備站在樹下看了一會兒，
sentences.pinyin: jiē biān yǒu yì xiē méi zi shù liú bèi zhàn zài shù xià kàn le yí huì'r
sentences.english: There were some plum trees on the side of the street. Liu Bei stood under the trees and watched for a while.

sentences.simplified: 想起自己以前在河南和曹操在梅子树下喝过酒，
sentences.traditional: 想起自己以前在河南和曹操在梅子樹下喝過酒，
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng qǐ zì jǐ yǐ qián zài hé nán hé cáo cāo zài méi zi shù xià hē guò jiǔ
sentences.english: He thought of the times when he and Cao Cao would drink together under the plum trees in Henan.

sentences.simplified: 他难过地说：“时间过得真快，已经十年了！”
sentences.traditional: 他難過地說：“時間過得真快，已經十年了！”
sentences.pinyin: tā nán guò de shuō shí jiān guò de zhēn kuài yǐ jīng shí nián le
sentences.english: He said sadly, “Time flies; it’s been ten years already!”

sentences.simplified: 没错，刘备从北方来南方已经十年了。
sentences.traditional: 沒錯，劉備從北方來南方已經十年了。
sentences.pinyin: méi cuò liú bèi cóng běi fāng lái nán fāng yǐ jīng shí nián le
sentences.english: Yes, it had been ten years since Liu Bei moved to the south from the north.

sentences.simplified: 这十年里他一直住在荆州。
sentences.traditional: 這十年裡他一直住在荊州。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí nián lǐ tā yì zhí zhù zài jīng zhōu
sentences.english: He had lived in Jingzhou for the entirety of these ten years.

sentences.simplified: 荆州的刘表有很多军队，他可以照顾刘备和刘备带来的人。
sentences.traditional: 荊州的劉表有很多軍隊，他可以照顧劉備和劉備帶來的人。
sentences.pinyin: jīng zhōu de liú biǎo yǒu hěn duō jūn duì tā kě yǐ zhào gù liú bèi hé liú bèi dài lái de rén
sentences.english: Liu Biao from Jingzhou had a lot of troops. He could take care of Liu Bei and the people that Liu Bei brought with him.

sentences.simplified: 当然，刘表也知道刘备是个有能力的人，
sentences.traditional: 當然，劉表也知道劉備是個有能力的人，
sentences.pinyin: dāng rán liú biǎo yě zhī dào liú bèi shì ge yǒu néng lì de rén
sentences.english: Of course, Liu Biao also knew that Liu Bei was a very capable person.

sentences.simplified: 把他留在荆州可以帮自己，所以他对刘备也不错。
sentences.traditional: 把他留在荊州可以幫自己，所以他對劉備也不錯。
sentences.pinyin: bǎ tā liú zài jīng zhōu kě yǐ bāng zì jǐ suǒ yǐ tā duì liú bèi yě bú cuò
sentences.english: He knew that keeping Liu Bei in Jingzhou could help him, so he treated Liu Bei well.

sentences.simplified: 但是，刘表的助手和将军们不这么想，他们觉得刘备太有能力了，
sentences.traditional: 但是，劉表的助手和將軍們不這麼想，他們覺得劉備太有能力了，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì liú biǎo de zhù shǒu hé jiāng jūn men bú zhè me xiǎng tā men jué de liú bèi tài yǒu néng lì le
sentences.english: However, Liu Biao’s assistants and generals did not feel this way. They thought that Liu Bei was too capable.

sentences.simplified: 把这样的人留在荆州不是什么好事。
sentences.traditional: 把這樣的人留在荊州不是什麼好事。
sentences.pinyin: bǎ zhè yàng de rén liú zài jīng zhōu bú shì shén me hǎo shì
sentences.english: Keeping such a person in Jingzhou was not a good thing.

sentences.simplified: 他们一直对刘表说，刘备是个危险的人，不能留他在荆州，还是杀了他吧。
sentences.traditional: 他們一直對劉表說，劉備是個危險的人，不能留他在荊州，還是殺了他吧。
sentences.pinyin: tā men yì zhí duì liú biǎo shuō liú bèi shì ge wēi xiǎn de rén bù néng liú tā zài jīng zhōu hái shi shā le tā ba
sentences.english: They kept telling Liu Biao that Liu Bei was a dangerous person who should not stay in Jingzhou. It would be better to kill him.

sentences.simplified: 刘表听得多了，慢慢也有点儿不相信刘备了。
sentences.traditional: 劉表聽得多了，慢慢也有點兒不相信劉備了。
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo tīng de duō le màn man yě yǒu diǎn'r bù xiāng xìn liú bèi le
sentences.english: After hearing this many times, Liu Biao also gradually began to mistrust Liu Bei a little.

sentences.simplified: 他不敢给刘备军队，也不敢让刘备做大官，
sentences.traditional: 他不敢給劉備軍隊，也不敢讓劉備做大官，
sentences.pinyin: tā bù gǎn gěi liú bèi jūn duì yě bù gǎn ràng liú bèi zuò dà guān
sentences.english: He did not dare to give Liu Bei troops and also did not dare to make Liu Bei a high official.

sentences.simplified: 只给了他一个叫“新也”的小城，让他好吃好穿地住在那里。
sentences.traditional: 只給了他一個叫“新也”的小城，讓他好吃好穿地住在那裡。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ gěi le tā yí ge jiào xīn yě de xiǎo chéng ràng tā hǎo chī hǎo chuān de zhù zài nà lǐ
sentences.english: He just gave him a small city called “Xinye” and allowed him to live there comfortably.

sentences.simplified: 刘表的一个大将军觉得刘表太胆小了，
sentences.traditional: 劉表的一個大將軍覺得劉表太膽小了，
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo de yí ge dà jiāng jūn jué de liú biǎo tài dǎn xiǎo le
sentences.english: One of Liu Biao’s important generals felt that Liu Biao was too timid.

sentences.simplified: 杀刘备是件容易的事，为什么不敢呢？
sentences.traditional: 殺劉備是件容易的事，為什麼不敢呢？
sentences.pinyin: shā liú bèi shì jiàn róng yì de shì wèi shén me bù gǎn ne
sentences.english: Killing Liu Bei was such an easy task. Why didn’t he dare to do it?

sentences.simplified: 有一天，这个将军请刘备去他家吃饭，想在饭桌上把刘备杀了。
sentences.traditional: 有一天，這個將軍請劉備去他家吃飯，想在飯桌上把劉備殺了。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yì tiān zhè ge jiāng jūn qǐng liú bèi qù tā jiā chī fàn xiǎng zài fàn zhuō shang bǎ liú bèi shā le
sentences.english: One day, this general invited Liu Bei to his home for dinner. He wanted to kill Liu Bei at the dinner table.

sentences.simplified: 但他没准备好，有人把他要杀刘备的事告诉了刘备。
sentences.traditional: 但他沒準備好，有人把他要殺劉備的事告訴了劉備。
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā méi zhǔn bèi hǎo yǒu rén bǎ tā yào shā liú bèi de shì gào su le liú bèi
sentences.english: But, he was not fully prepared, and someone told Liu Bei that he wanted to kill him.

sentences.simplified: 刘备听了，饭也没吃，马上骑着马从小路跑了。
sentences.traditional: 劉備聽了，飯也沒吃，馬上騎著馬從小路跑了。
sentences.pinyin: liú bèi tīng le fàn yě méi chī mǎ shàng qí zhe mǎ cóng xiǎo lù pǎo le
sentences.english: Liu Bei heard and immediately got on his horse and fled using the back roads without eating his dinner.

sentence_translations: Chapter 1: Ten Years
This is a small city in the south called Xinye. Liu Bei, in his forties, was riding his horse slowly on the street.
There were quite a few people on the street. People came and went, passing by him, but he did not look at them.
There were some plum trees on the side of the street. Liu Bei stood under the trees and watched for a while.
He thought of the times when he and Cao Cao would drink together under the plum trees in Henan.
He said sadly, “Time flies; it’s been ten years already!”
Yes, it had been ten years since Liu Bei moved to the south from the north.
He had lived in Jingzhou for the entirety of these ten years.
Liu Biao from Jingzhou had a lot of troops. He could take care of Liu Bei and the people that Liu Bei brought with him.
Of course, Liu Biao also knew that Liu Bei was a very capable person.
He knew that keeping Liu Bei in Jingzhou could help him, so he treated Liu Bei well.
However, Liu Biao’s assistants and generals did not feel this way. They thought that Liu Bei was too capable.
Keeping such a person in Jingzhou was not a good thing.
They kept telling Liu Biao that Liu Bei was a dangerous person who should not stay in Jingzhou. It would be better to kill him.
After hearing this many times, Liu Biao also gradually began to mistrust Liu Bei a little.
He did not dare to give Liu Bei troops and also did not dare to make Liu Bei a high official.
He just gave him a small city called “Xinye” and allowed him to live there comfortably.
One of Liu Biao’s important generals felt that Liu Biao was too timid.
Killing Liu Bei was such an easy task. Why didn’t he dare to do it?
One day, this general invited Liu Bei to his home for dinner. He wanted to kill Liu Bei at the dinner table.
But, he was not fully prepared, and someone told Liu Bei that he wanted to kill him.
Liu Bei heard and immediately got on his horse and fled using the back roads without eating his dinner.
